description: WRITE: create a new, empty mailing list. Returns the new list's ID. Moosend: POST /lists/create.json.

confirmation_page.description: URL shown at the end of the subscription process.

is_required.description: Whether a choice is required. Default false.

redirect_after_unsubscribe_page.description: URL subscribers are redirected to after unsubscribing.
